rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 2AB blastocyst, but it overstates certainty about ICM location/compactness, TE cohesion, cytoplasmic health, and even gives a fabricated zona thickness measurement not reliably discernible from the image.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, prior IVF outcomes, endometrium, BMI, and sperm data reasonably well with embryo quality, though some links are somewhat speculative.

The logic is structured and mostly internally consistent, especially around age-related aneuploidy moderating morphology, though a few quantitative modifiers and statements are not strongly evidence-based.

Mostly aligned with standard IVF principles and Gardner grading context, but some claims exceed what morphology alone can support and the probability adjustments are more heuristic than guideline-based.
The recommendations section is truncated and does not provide complete, specific next steps for transfer management or future cycle planning.
